H01.description: The nub.lock entry checks the 'patches' directory even though patch hashes are already in the lockfile, so the optimizer hash depends on the patches dir state needlessly and can trigger spurious re-optimization.

I01.description: The yarn.lock fallback lockfile entry checks '.yarn/patches' even though patches are recorded in the lockfile, causing unnecessary patches-dir dependence in the optimizer hash; the head line number is inferred from the fix commit's offset.
